title: Rectitude Holdings Ltd. Announces Acquisition of MR. BUTLER PTE. LTD. and Executes Business Migration Agreements with INOS and G & L
summary: Rectitude has signed a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Mr. Butler, adding household goods repair and personal service activities to its product portfolio.
